body.title: Flood probability (river discharge above Q10)
body.note: Q10 = 432.5 m³/s (River discharge exceeded 10 % of the months Jan 2000 – Aug 2026); the probability assumes a normal distribution centred on the forecast median with the 10–90 % band as its spread. Statistical forecast (Random Forest, skill vs climatology 0.03, data to Aug 2026). Statistical forecast from historical data; not an official SAWS / DWS outlook.
